tips.tip_34: Create {highlight}opencode.json{/highlight} for server settings and {highlight}tui.json{/highlight} for TUI settings
tips.tip_35: Place TUI settings in {highlight}~/.config/opencode/tui.json{/highlight} for global config
tips.tip_36: Add {highlight}$schema{/highlight} to your config for autocomplete in your editor
tips.tip_37: Configure {highlight}model{/highlight} in config to set your default model
tips.tip_38: Override any keybind in {highlight}tui.json{/highlight} via the {highlight}keybinds{/highlight} section
tips.tip_39: Set any keybind to {highlight}none{/highlight} to disable it completely
tips.tip_40: Configure local or remote MCP servers in the {highlight}mcp{/highlight} config section
tips.tip_41: Add {highlight}.md{/highlight} files to {highlight}.opencode/commands/{/highlight} to define reusable custom prompts
tips.tip_42: Use {highlight}$ARGUMENTS{/highlight}, {highlight}$1{/highlight}, {highlight}$2{/highlight} in custom commands for dynamic input
tips.tip_43: Use backticks in commands to inject shell output (e.g., {highlight}`git status`{/highlight})
tips.tip_44: Add {highlight}.md{/highlight} files to {highlight}.opencode/agents/{/highlight} for specialized AI personas
tips.tip_45: Configure per-agent permissions for {highlight}edit{/highlight}, {highlight}bash{/highlight}, and {highlight}webfetch{/highlight} tools
tips.tip_46: Use patterns like {highlight}"git *": "allow"{/highlight} for granular bash permissions
tips.tip_48: Configure {highlight}"git push": "ask"{/highlight} to require approval before pushing
tips.tip_49: Set {highlight}"formatter": true{/highlight} in config to enable built-in formatters like prettier, gofmt, and ruff
tips.tip_50: Set {highlight}"formatter": false{/highlight} in config to disable formatters enabled by another config layer
tips.tip_51: Define custom formatter commands with file extensions in config
tips.tip_52: Set {highlight}"lsp": true{/highlight} in config to enable built-in LSP servers for code analysis
tips.tip_53: Create {highlight}.ts{/highlight} files in {highlight}.opencode/tools/{/highlight} to define new LLM tools
tips.tip_54: Tool definitions can invoke scripts written in Python, Go, etc
tips.tip_55: Add {highlight}.ts{/highlight} files to {highlight}.opencode/plugins/{/highlight} for event hooks
tips.tip_56: Use plugins to send OS notifications when sessions complete
tips.tip_57: Create a plugin to prevent OpenCode from reading sensitive files
tips.tip_59: Use {highlight}opencode --continue{/highlight} to resume the last session
tips.tip_60: Use {highlight}opencode run -f file.ts{/highlight} to attach files via CLI
tips.tip_61: Use {highlight}--format json{/highlight} for machine-readable output in scripts
tips.tip_62: Run {highlight}opencode serve{/highlight} for headless API access to OpenCode
tips.tip_63: Use {highlight}opencode run --attach{/highlight} to connect to a running server
tips.tip_64: Run {highlight}opencode upgrade{/highlight} to update to the latest version
tips.tip_65: Run {highlight}opencode auth list{/highlight} to see all configured providers
tips.tip_66: Run {highlight}opencode agent create{/highlight} for guided agent creation
tips.tip_67: Use {highlight}/opencode{/highlight} in GitHub issues/PRs to trigger AI actions
tips.tip_68: Run {highlight}opencode github install{/highlight} to set up the GitHub workflow
tips.tip_69: Comment {highlight}/opencode fix this{/highlight} on issues to auto-create PRs
tips.tip_70: Comment {highlight}/oc{/highlight} on PR code lines for targeted code reviews
tips.tip_71: Use {highlight}"theme": "system"{/highlight} to match your terminal's colors
tips.tip_72: Create JSON theme files in {highlight}.opencode/themes/{/highlight} directory
tips.tip_73: Themes support dark/light variants for both modes
tips.tip_74: Use numeric xterm color codes 0-255 in custom theme JSON
tips.tip_75: Use {highlight}{env:VAR_NAME}{/highlight} syntax to reference environment variables in config
tips.tip_76: Use {highlight}{file:path}{/highlight} to include file contents in config values
tips.tip_77: Use {highlight}instructions{/highlight} in config to load additional rules files
tips.tip_79: to toggle code block visibility in messages
tips.tip_81: Enable {highlight}scroll_acceleration{/highlight} in {highlight}tui.json{/highlight} for smooth macOS-style scrolling
tips.tip_82: Toggle username display in chat via the command palette ({shortcut})
tips.tip_82_fallback: Toggle username display in chat via the command palette
tips.tip_83: Run {highlight}docker run -it --rm ghcr.io/anomalyco/opencode{/highlight} for containerized use
tips.tip_84: Use {highlight}/connect{/highlight} with OpenCode Zen for curated, tested models
tips.tip_85: Commit your project's {highlight}AGENTS.md{/highlight} file to Git for team sharing
tips.tip_86: Use {highlight}/review{/highlight} to review uncommitted changes, branches, or PRs
tips.tip_88: Use {highlight}/rename{/highlight} to rename the current session
tips.tip_89: to undo changes in your prompt
tips.tip_90: to suspend the terminal and return to your shell
